member.name: T:RPPP_WebApp.Controllers.IncidentReportController
member.summary: MVC controller responsible for managing Incident Reports. Provides CRUD operations, master-detail editing of affected items (Affects), and export of reports to PDF and Excel formats.
member.remarks:
This controller handles:
Paged and sorted listing of incident reports
Creation, editing, and deletion of reports
Master-detail view for managing items affected by the incident
Batch updating of affected items details
Generation of full log PDF and master-detail Excel reports
